description: Search annual indicators, qualified economic definitions, other source time series, onchain instruments and companies. Preserve kind, exact identity, units and source terms. geo filters historical source membership in economic and series results; it does not establish freshness or reviewed national definitions. Retain version when paging.

geo.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code or aggregate code (e.g. USA, DEU, EU27). Matches historical source membership, not freshness.

kind.description: Limit results to one catalog: annual country indicators, reviewed economic definitions, other source time series, onchain instruments or SEC companies.

market.description: Onchain results only: token pools or perpetual derivatives.

query.description: Search text, up to 120 characters (e.g. "unemployment", "Brazil GDP").

source.description: Source code to filter by, e.g. imf, wb, oecd, eurostat, bls, statcan_wds, ibge_headlines.

version.description: Catalog version returned by the first page. Pass it back when paging so every page comes from the same catalog.

name: search_data
